labelStatus: Curated provisional labels from an independent corpus author; no consensus or human adjudication.
retrievalLabelSemantics: relevantDocumentIds and forbiddenDocumentIds label document-level retrieval. A forbidden result is an adjudicated confusable retrieval candidate, not a measured identity merge.

limitations: Six documents and 20 retrieval queries do not support population-level retrieval claims.
The corpus does not reproduce live corpus size, HNSW planner selection, or production filtering.
Entailment labels are provisional curated judgments rather than consensus or human-adjudicated gold labels.
Categorical entailment predictions contain no probabilities, so probability calibration is unavailable.
Forbidden-document retrieval measures candidate-level false positives; resolver false-merge behavior remains unmeasured.
